verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a real robots.txt returning HTTP 200 on the SOSDirect filing host, and it names specific agents (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot), so an agent can tell what it may fetch there before fetching anything else. The evidence covers only that one host, and its rules disallow those agents. Missing for 10: any evidence of a robots.txt on the primary www.sos.state.tx.us site or the new SOSPortal host, first-party documentation of crawler or agent policy, and independent corroboration beyond a single probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://direct.sos.state.tx.us/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-05; named bans — GPTBot present, ChatGPT-User present, OAI-SearchBot present, Googlebot present)
the direct.sos.state.tx.us filing host's robots.txt disallows AI crawlers by name and was respected
